description_expanded:
The Silver Sand Dollar | Watercolor, FL

88 Bluejack Street Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459

*Interior remodel expected to be completed Spring 2026! All new kitchen, flooring, and paint and more! New photos to come! The Silver Sand Dollar is located in the Lake District of Watercolor surrounded by the beautiful nature preserve. This residence offers 5 bedrooms (including a bonus room and bunk room), 4 bathrooms, a 6-seat golf cart/LSV, and a wonderful outdoor space that is perfect for slowing down and relaxing.

The first floor of this home features a spacious living room for all to gather around. You will feel connected throughout the open floor that flows from the living room into the dining and kitchen area. The dining room offers stylish seating for 8 guests and bar stool seating for 5 guests. The kitchen comes complete with stainless steel appliances and plenty of counter space for creating gourmet meals. There is a bonus guest room on the first floor with a full-size bed and shared access to the hall bathroom. The screened in porch is the heart of the home, along with the balcony spaces on the second floor, that make relaxing and time together that much more enjoyable. There is a laundry room on this floor for convenience.

The second floor offers a guest bedroom with a queen-sized bed and shared bathroom with the bunk room. The bunk room has a twin over twin bunk bed. There are two master bedrooms, one on the front of the home and one on the back of the home. Each master bedroom has a king-sized bed, private bathroom with a walk-in shower, and a balcony boasting stunning views of Watercolor!

*Interior remodel expected to be completed Spring 2026! All new kitchen, flooring, and paint and more! New photos to come!

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

Sleeps 10

5 Bedrooms (including a bonus room + bunk room)

4 Full Bathrooms

2,560 Square Feet

Large Kitchen

Cuisinart Coffee Center: 12-Cup Pot and Single-Serve Brewer

6-Seat Golf Cart/LSV

Outdoor Space

Beautiful Views of Watercolor

Close to the Sandhill Pool

Complimentary Trolley Rides via WaterColor Trolley App

10 Amenity Wristbands

Access to All WaterColor Community Swimming Pools - Camp WaterColor and the Beach Club

First Floor

- Bonus guest room with full size bed and shared access to the hall bathroom

- Hall bathroom with vanity and shower/tub combo

- Cozy living room with comfortable seating, Smart TV, and fireplace

- Spacious kitchen with stainless steel appliances

- Dining table seating for 8 and bar stool seating for 5 guests

- Screened-in porch with ample seating and outdoor dining table

- Laundry room

Second Floor

- Guest bedroom with queen sized bed and shared full bath

- Full bathroom shared between the queen bedroom and bunk room

- Guest bedroom with a twin over twin bunk bed

- Master suite with private bathroom with a single vanity sink, walk-in shower and access to the front balcony

- Additional master suite with a private bathroom with a double vanity sink, walk-in shower, and access to the rear balcony

Outdoor Space

- Dining tables for alfresco dining

- First and second floor porch and balcony spaces

- Grill

- 6-seat golf cart/LSV

- Parking for 2 vehicles

- 5 beach cruiser bicycles

Additional

- Guests can enjoy complimentary rides anywhere in WaterColor using the on-demand WaterColor Trolley, available through the WaterColor Trolley app in your app store.

- Parking for 2 vehicles.

- No events, such as wedding receptions and other large gatherings are allowed. Only people sleeping in the home are allowed on this property. If violated, double cleaning fees, as well as other possible fees, will apply.

- No pet home. Per the signed Rental Agreement, any violation of the no pet policy will result in immediate eviction, plus additional cleaning charges.

- WaterColor HOA allows one golf cart/LSV per address- you may not rent a second cart/LSV if the home you have rented offers one. All golf cart/LSV rentals in Watercolor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to a specific amount throughout the community at any given time. Cart/LSV rentals are granted on a first-come, first-served based. Watercolor condos cannot rent golf carts/LSVs.

- 10 Amenity Wristbands - Maximum. Extras are not available. Access to All WaterColor Community Swimming Pools - Camp WaterColor and the Beach Club.

- The HOA issues one parking pass per reservation. Guests are encouraged to park their vehicles in the driveway or garage of their rental home. They do not need a parking pass when their vehicle is parked on a private residential property.The HOA-issued parking pass is required to park a vehicle overnight on the common area parking pads.

Reservation/Booking Policy

- Minimum Age: All properties require a minimum of one adult over the age of 26 be staying at the property throughout the rental term.

- A 50% deposit is due at the time of booking.

- Except for a $250 Cancellation Fee, deposits are fully refundable if cancellations are given 60 days prior to the arrival date.

- Balance of payment is due 60 days prior to the arrival date.

- Check-in begins at 4:00 PM and check-out is by 10:00 AM.

- Cleaning: Reservations made for more than 12 nights require a full clean during your stay. This will be added onto your total when checking out. Reservations for less than 12 days, have the option to add a mid-stay clean onto your reservation.
